issue_request: FHIR-47931 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 OO change request asking for clearer DeviceAssociation Boundaries and Relationships guidance on when to use DeviceAssociation versus DeviceUsage or Procedure.
initial_application: The change was applied in 8e08ddcec80d96adf118472a5582e3979379ca12, whose subject was "FHIR-47604, FHIR-47931", and merged by PR #3872 as d4945df882f8cf2f63f39d38e869cfcc0a5bd9b6. That patch replaced the old nested DeviceUsage/Procedure text in source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation-introduction.xml with separate DeviceAssociation, Device, DeviceUsage, and Procedure entries plus combined-use and Observation settings paragraphs.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active current-build source in source/fhir.ini. DeviceUsage is not listed as an active core resource, and the device module links DeviceUsage and DeviceDispense to the OO incubator; later commit 01706a920f4e88452c409c2cc0b7c74f09ac51c6 updated the DeviceUsage link in the DeviceAssociation B&R text to the current OO incubator URL while preserving the clarification. Confluence OO/HCP minutes align with the Jira vote and HCP/editor wording path, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation-introduction.xml already satisfies the Jira request, and changing the DeviceUsage link back to a core page would conflict with current build scope.
